consent.location_message:
Cheep only uses your approximate location to show you the nearest store branches and real distances. Your location stays on your device, isn't collected in the background, and isn't shared with third parties.

This is NOT required to use the service; you can keep using Cheep even if you decline. You can withdraw your consent anytime from Profile › Privacy.
consent.gate_message: We need location permission for the best results: it is the only way we can show the store branches nearest to you and real walking/driving distances. Without it we cannot rank nearby stores.

profile.about_body:
Cheep · Version {{version}}
Find the best price.

Data sources
• Türkiye: marketfiyati.org.tr — the official public price platform of the Ministry of Trade of the Republic of Türkiye.
• Poland: prices published publicly by the retailers on their own websites.
• Product information: Open Food Facts, licensed under ODbL.

Cheep is not affiliated with, and not endorsed by, any retailer. Prices are informational and may differ from in-store prices.
